description: This class defines the OrderTotal entity representing total-related information for an order, including fields like code, title, value, and relations to Order. It includes annotations for ORM mapping using JPA/Hibernate.

classes.name: OrderTotal
classes.description: Entity class representing a total component related to an order, including order total code, title, text, value, module, types, and association to an Order.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of this OrderTotal object.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for this OrderTotal object.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of the order total (e.g., Shipping, Tax).

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the order total.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Returns the additional textual description of the order total.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Sets the textual description of the order total.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the monetary value of the order total.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the monetary value of the order total.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Returns the module associated with this total (e.g., shipping module).

methods.name: setModule
methods.description: Sets the module associated with this total.

methods.name: getSortOrder
methods.description: Returns the sorting order index of this total.

methods.name: setSortOrder
methods.description: Sets the sorting order index of this total.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Gets the Order object associated with this total.

methods.name: setOrder
methods.description: Associates this total with a particular Order.

methods.name: getOrderTotalCode
methods.description: Returns the code indicating the type of total (e.g., SHIPPING, TAX).

methods.name: setOrderTotalCode
methods.description: Sets the code indicating the type of total.

methods.name: getOrderValueType
methods.description: Returns the order value type (e.g., ONE_TIME).

methods.name: setOrderValueType
methods.description: Sets the order value type.

methods.name: getOrderTotalType
methods.description: Returns the total type.

methods.name: setOrderTotalType
methods.description: Sets the total type.
